confirm.title: Set up {name}
confirm.description: Leave the passkey blank and a random one is generated and set on this A/C automatically. Fill it in only if this A/C already has a passkey — it will be used as-is. You can view or change it later from the A/C's Passkey controls.

error.invalid_pin: The passkey must be exactly 4 digits.

abort.no_devices_found: No A/Cs found. Make sure the A/C is powered and in range of a Bluetooth adapter or an ESPHome Bluetooth proxy.
abort.already_configured: This A/C is already set up.

init.title: Connection
init.description: The A/C pushes its status as 41-byte frames, so the link needs an ATT MTU of at least 44. An ESPHome Bluetooth proxy negotiates a large one; this host's adapter often sticks at 23, where the frames are dropped and the unit looks switched off for ever. Proxies Home Assistant can see right now: {proxies}.
